CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of Good Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Principles of Good Stewardship has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Principles of Good Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of Good Stewardship.
   D. Apply the teaching of Principles of Good Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Judges? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Judges has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected Judges to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Judges with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Judges.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Journey to Jerusalem: has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Journey to Jerusalem: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem:.

   A. Use Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Say Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Conquest and settlement in Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conquest and settlement in Canaan.
   B. Use Conquest and settlement in Canaan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Conquest and settlement in Canaan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Conquest and settlement in Canaan has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Writing the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Writing the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Writing the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Writing the Holy Bible.
   D. Say Writing the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

10. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Say Journey to Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem.
   C. Use Journey to Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

12. Which response best shows understanding of Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Response to Modern Science and Technology Artificial Intelligence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Response to Modern Medicine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Studying the Holy Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Writing the Holy Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
